channel.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
channel.desc: Beginning on the Moray Firth, Michael admires the impressive Cullen viaduct before enjoying a bowl of Cullen skink at a family-run fishmonger of 150 years' standing. Heading west along the firth, Michael reaches Forres Station and the seaside village of Findhorn, where he meets members of an eco-community founded in the 1960s. At the Findhorn Foundation, Michael discovers spiritual energy, sacred dancing and a history of very large vegetables.

channel.desc: Off the coast of Yorkshire, Siwrengale is heading out for the beginning of the North Sea whelk season. Skipper Darren Warters is on the hunt with sons Regan and Lewis. Asian demand has created a lucrative fishery in this small patch of the North Sea, but winter storms have badly damaged their pots. Miles of rope must be untangled before they can begin fishing in earnest. South-east of Shetland is 'Long Hole' - the deepest waters in the North Sea.

Between them, the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectibles to be sold at auction. James discovers a collection of watches that have been in the back of a wardrobe for years and David finds a pistol dating back to the Battle of Waterloo.

channel.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2

The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

channel.title: Celebrity Race Across the World

Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book.

channel.desc: Concerto in la minore per pianoforte e orchestra, composto nel 1868 e dedicato al pianista Edmund Neupert - Julia Fischer, pianoforte - Junge Deutsche Philharmonie.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Mestiere Teatro
channel.desc: Un viaggio alla scoperta di quanti nei teatri, lontano dalla ribalta, in ufficio, nei laboratori, dietro le quinte, nella buca, lavorano per la riuscita e il successo di uno spettacolo. A cura di Paolo Gavazzeni.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Tutino - La lupa
channel.desc: Melodramma \(1990\) in un atto e due quadri composto da Marco Tutino su libretto di G.Di Leva - con Nino Surguladze, Irina Lungu, Sergio Escobar - F.M.Carminati, dir. - D.Livermore, reg. \(Catania, Teatro Bellini - 2024\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Tutino - Il berretto a sonagli
channel.desc: Melodramma \(2024\) in un atto e due quadri su libretto di F.Ceresa - con Valentina Bilancione, Laura Verrecchia, Rosario La Spina - F.M.Carminati, dir. - D.Livermore, reg. \(Catania, Teatro Bellini - 2024\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Dittico Tutino - backstage
channel.desc: Un documentario girato dietro le quinte del dittico di Marco Tutino messo in scena da Davide Livermore al Teatro Bellini di Catania: Il berretto a sonagli, in prima mondiale, e La lupa - Francesco Fei, reg. \(2024\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Almanacco di Bellezza
channel.desc: Piero Maranghi, direttore di Sky Classica, passa in rassegna, anniversari e ricorrenze legati al mondo dell'arte, della cultura, della storia e dello sport. In studio con lui, il collezionista ed esperto d'arte Leonardo Piccinini.

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Bellini - Norma
channel.desc: Tragedia lirica in due atti \(1831\) su libretto di F.Romani - con A.Grigorian, A.Akhmetshina, F.De Tommaso, T.Nazmi, V.Leshkevich, G.Quaresma - Wiener Symphoniker - F.Lanzillotta, dir. - V.Barkhatov, reg. \(Vienna, 2025\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Mozart - Serenata per fiati n.10
channel.desc: Serenata in si bemolle maggiore K 361, detta la Gran Partita, composta nel 1781 ed eseguita la prima volta a Vienna nel 1784 - I Solisti della Votto - Paolo Rossini, dir. \(Piacenza, Sala dei Teatini - 2026\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Mourad Merzouki - Kaleidoscope
channel.desc: Per i 10 anni del Festival Kalypso il coreografo francese Merzouki crea un caleidoscopio di spettacoli realizzati tra il 1996 e il 2021 - con S.Amada, R.Autechaud, K.Belmoktar - H.Newhouse, sop. - B.Lebreton, reg. \(2022\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Yehudi Menuhin - Prova
channel.desc: Il violinista Menuhin e il direttore d'orchestra Karajan conversano prima di eseguire il Concerto n.5 in la maggiore per violino e orchestra \(1775\) di W.A.Mozart, KV219 - Wiener Symphoniker - regia di H.-G.Clouzot \(1966\).

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: At home with Daniil Trifonov
channel.desc: Il giovane pianista russo attraversa il grande repertorio musicale tra Otto e Novecento, dalle pagine di Skrjabin, Cajkovskij, Rachmaninov, fino a Ravel, Bach e Prokof'ev - Daniel Trifonov, pf. \(Connecticut, 2024\).

channel.name: Classica IT

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: R.Wagner - Tristano e Isotta

channel.name: Classica IT
channel.title: Giovanni Gavazzeni racconta

channel.desc: Fr. McGuckian discusses the increased devotion to the Kingship of Christ in the 1800s and 1900s. He also examines the Feast of Christ the King and the papal encyclical Quas Primas. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! They Might Be Saints Fr. Dolindo Ruotolo
channel.desc: Discover the life and spirituality of Italian Fr. Dolindo Ruotolo, a victim soul for humanity whose spiritual writings and the "Surrender Novena" are gaining worldwide popularity. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! At Home With Jim And Joy
channel.desc: Jim and Joy welcome author Patti Maguire Armstrong to share the story of Michelle Duppong, whose short life of suffering became a source of hope that set countless hearts ablaze. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Ewtn News Nightly
channel.desc: EWTN News Nightly is our daily news and analysis program presenting breaking Catholic News worldwide, top stories, and daily reports from the White House, Capitol Hill, and Rome. Weekdays at 6 & 9 PM EST. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Syria, This Is Not The End
channel.desc: It is a collection of testimonies of faith and courage by Christians who endured war conditions for years. The Syrian people have suffered and are suffering in their daily lives because of the economic embargo. In the midst of this misery, Father Hugo, a Catholic priest, and his team have developed an aid network that meets the basic needs of the most vulnerable people. But beyond material aid, what makes a difference is the glimmer of hope that their Christian faith brings. This very moving testimony shows how adversity can strengthen faith, hope and love. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Bob And Penny Lord Present
channel.desc: While visiting Lourdes, France, Bob and Penny Lord share how St. Bernadette became a great saint and why millions of pilgrims still travel to Lourdes. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: They Might Be Saints: Fr. Patrick Peyton
channel.desc: A look at the charismatic priest who pioneered the use of radio and TV to bring the rosary to the world, staging massive rallies and enlisting Hollywood celebrities in his singular mission. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Ewtn Live
channel.desc: Actor David Henrie joins Fr. Mitch Pacwa to discuss the beautiful challenge of explaining God's greatness and the immensity of His boundless love to the youngest hearts among us. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Faithful Traveler In Portugal
channel.desc: Beyond its fame for wine Porto boasts the brilliant Cathedral and gold-covered Igreja da Sao Francisco. Journey to Cais da Ribeira for a meal and tour the Ferriera Port Wine House. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Where God Weeps
channel.desc: Bishop Francis Bomansaan speaks with Mark Riedemann about one of Ghana?s poorest regions where land water disputes and political representation often trigger violent clashes. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn News Nightly
channel.desc: EWTN News Nightly is our daily news and analysis program presenting breaking Catholic News worldwide, top stories, and daily reports from the White House, Capitol Hill, and Rome. Weekdays at 6 & 9 PM EST. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Daily Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, AL. (LIVE DAILY at 8 am Eastern). (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Holy Land Rosary
channel.desc: Father Mitch Pacwa gives short meditations on each of the Five Mysteries of Light introduced by Pope John Paul II. (20 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Litany Of The Most Blessed Sacrament
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word as they recite a litany in honor of the Most Blessed Sacrament from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Saints Of China: Martyrs Of The Middle Kingdom
channel.desc: Dr. Anthony Clark focuses on the Chinese Catholic saints who died for the faith on their native soil. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Journey Home
channel.desc: Eric Anderson came from a Presbyterian background, graduating with degrees in philosophy and theology from Whitworth University. While working on a masters in theology at Princeton Seminary, he felt as though his studies were leading both academically and personally closer and closer to the Catholic Faith. A friendship with a fellow Catholic academic helped facilitate that journey into the Church, which culminated at the Easter Vigil in 2023. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Women Of Grace
channel.desc: Author Maria Palma Smith continues presenting Don Dolindo Ruotolo's mystical gifts of bilocation, prophecy, and healing, and why God entrusts such extraordinary graces to souls. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Choices We Face
channel.desc: Ralph Martin?s granddaughter, Annie Baldante, joins to discuss how the Lord invited her to choose Him, develop a prayer life, and serve in middle school ministry. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Freedom And Authority
channel.desc: In episode 2 Father Dubay defines the types of freedom and gives examples of how they can be applied in our lives. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Papal Audience With Pope Leo Xiv
channel.desc: From the Vatican, Pope Leo XIV delivers his weekly address to the faithful. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Becoming Catholic
channel.desc: Fr. Krause talks about the teaching of Jesus Christ on the Kingdom of God, the beatitudes, and how the Incarnation was God's answer to suffering and death. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Chaplet Of Divine Mercy
channel.desc: From the chapel of the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy in Stockbridge, Massachusetts. (20 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Reflections With Fr. Leo Clifford
channel.desc: Father Leo Clifford develops the Parable of the Good Samaritan as the motivation for a philosophy of life for a Christian. Seen from the perspective of how we use God's gifts, we are called to help others on our path - not ignore them. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Explore With The Miracle Hunter
channel.desc: Hear of the powerful devotion to Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Santiago, Chile, and her role in the nation?s fight for independence during the events around the Battle of Maip?. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Kingship Of Christ
channel.desc: Fr. McGuckian discusses the increased devotion to the Kingship of Christ in the 1800s and 1900s. He also examines the Feast of Christ the King and the papal encyclical Quas Primas. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: We Are Catholic
channel.desc: Fr. Charles prays for the intercession of St. Claire for Sr. Lali?s mission in the Philippines. Phillip is confused, and doesn?t understand why he can?t just pray directly to Jesus, but learns why after the owner of the cookie factory comes for dinner. (30 minutes).[(96057)]
